title: Hoglin Fix Mod
description: Tiny Mod for Hoglin Update. Now Hoglins LOVES Crimson Funguses and... you can kill them
body: The Hoglin Fix Mod is a mod that slightly improves Hoglins. 1. Hoglins will now chase the player if they're holding a Crimson Fungus. This will be a big help for farmers (if anyone's seriously building Hoglin pens). 2. Hoglin Meat. It drops from adult Hoglins. It's better than pork and can be cooked. With this mod, you can survive in the Nether with new meat and also attract Hoglins!
